.1 Drilling fluid recommendation This section of the well drills through the highly reactive shales of the lower Nordaland and upper Hordaland groups. These have been highly problematic in offset wells, giving typical problems of gumbo, pack-offs, wellbore collapse and stuck pipe. The Anco 2000 system is recommended for this section, due to its high inhibition properties, and previous success in maintaining control o
